## Instructions

1. Mix the meat, oats, egg, onion, half the soup, salt and pepper.
2. Pack into a loaf pan.
3. Spread the rest of the soup on top, and ketchup if you like.
4. Bake at 350 °F about 1 1/4 hours. Pour off the fat before slicing.

## Notes

"Stretch it with more oats at the end of the month." Written at the bottom in pencil.
